language.description: Which language the ideas and verses are of: 'grc' (Koine Greek, the verses carry `greek`) or 'he' (Biblical Hebrew, the verses carry `hebrew` and `hebrew_words`). Left out, it is 'grc'.

ideas.description: The one to three grammar ideas he missed most in the round he just finished, the most missed first. In Greek they are the ideas of the Greek ladder; in Hebrew (`language` 'he'), of the Hebrew ladder, with ids that start 'he-'.

id.description: The idea's id in the app. Copy it into each item's `idea`.

title.description: The idea's name, such as 'The second declension'.

what.description: The idea in a short paragraph, as the app teaches it.

misses.description: How many times he missed it in the round.

verses.description: Verses of the passage he is reading that use these ideas, the easiest for him first. Every item is made from one of them and from nothing else.

ref.description: Such as 'Romans 8:1'. Copy it into each item's `ref`.

greek.description: A Greek verse's Greek, the words as the text has them, separated by spaces. Missing in a Hebrew request.

hebrew.description: A Hebrew verse's Hebrew, the words as the text has them (pointed, no cantillation marks), separated by spaces; a word with a maqaf or an inseparable prefix is one word. Missing in a Greek request.

hebrew_words.description: A Hebrew verse's words, in order, each once: the form as it stands in `hebrew`, its dictionary form, transliteration, the lexicon's gloss and its parsing in plain words. Missing in a Greek request.

parse.description: What the word is, in plain words.

english.description: The verse's English as the translators wrote it.

uses.description: The words of the verse that use one of the ideas.

idea.description: The id of the idea the word uses.

form.description: The word as the verse has it (a Hebrew word as `hebrew` has it).

parse.description: What the word is, in plain words.

per_idea.description: How many items to make for each idea.

seen.description: Questions he has already been asked on these ideas, the oldest first. Write none of them and none that tests the same word.

prompt.description: The question as he was asked it.

ref.description: The verse it was about, such as 'Romans 8:1'.
